skill.name: tavily-search
skill.description: Use the Tavily API to search the web for current information, answer timely questions, and research topics.
skill.summary: Search the web with Tavily for current research and fact checking.
skill.author: CK991357

content.value_statement: AI assistants often lack current information for news, prices, releases, and fast-moving topics. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to call Tavily Search with clear query parameters.
actual_capabilities: Shows the expected Tavily Search tool-call shape.
Defines the required query parameter for searches.
Provides examples for current news and topic research.
Warns against common malformed JSON patterns.
Supports fact checking with current web results.
limitations: Requires an available tavily_search tool integration.
Search quality depends on Tavily results and query wording.
Does not define API keys, authentication, or rate limits.
User queries may be sent to the Tavily service.

use_cases.title: Research Current Events
use_cases.description: Find recent news, announcements, and public updates that may not exist in the model context.

use_cases.title: Verify Time-Sensitive Facts
use_cases.description: Check prices, release details, policy changes, or data points before using them in an answer.

use_cases.title: Gather Topic Background
use_cases.description: Collect current context for a product, company, technology, or market before writing a summary.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Current Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Tavily for the latest information about [topic]. Summarize the most relevant findings and include dates when available.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Claim
prompt_templates.scenario: Fact check a statement before using it.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily to verify this claim: [claim]. Explain whether current sources support it and mention any uncertainty.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Recent Sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Review multiple search results for a balanced answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Tavily for [topic]. Compare the strongest recent sources and identify agreements, conflicts, and missing context.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Research Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis for a timely research task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily searches to research [topic] from multiple angles. Produce a concise brief with key facts, recent changes, risks, and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Search for the latest OpenAI model release information.
output_examples.output: A current summary of recent release details, publication dates, and source agreement.

output_examples.input: Verify whether Bitcoin reached a new high this week.
output_examples.output: A checked answer that states the latest available price context and any source limits.

output_examples.input: Research Python 3.12 features for a short article.
output_examples.output: A concise feature summary with current context and suggested points to confirm.

best_practices: Use specific search terms with names, dates, locations, or product versions.
Run separate searches for complex questions before synthesizing an answer.
State source freshness and uncertainty when results conflict.
anti_patterns: Do not send private, secret, or regulated data as search queries.
Do not treat one search result as final proof for important claims.
Do not embed Markdown fences inside JSON tool parameters.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It teaches an assistant how to call Tavily Search with a query parameter for current web research.

faq.question: Does it include the Tavily API itself?
faq.answer: No. It assumes the tavily_search tool is already available in the host environment.

faq.question: Can it answer questions about recent events?
faq.answer: Yes. It is intended for timely topics where search results can improve the answer.

faq.question: Does it store search results?
faq.answer: No storage behavior is defined in the skill file. The host tool integration controls data handling.

faq.question: Is it suitable for fact checking?
faq.answer: Yes, but users should compare multiple results for important or disputed claims.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
